questions.stem: What does the Cloud provider make available to customers in PaaS?
options: Only bare virtual machines with an operating system
Software already installed and ready to use, with compute and storage managed automatically
questions.explanation: In PaaS all software is made available pre-installed and ready to use, and customers do not manage compute or storage.

questions.stem: Which phrase summarises PaaS in a nutshell?
options: Only infrastructure with no support to maintain software
Platforms, i.e. software with infrastructure and storage
questions.explanation: 'In nutshell, Platforms i.e., software(s) with infrastructure and storage is PaaS.'

questions.stem: In PaaS, what is provided for an Oracle database?
options: A fully built data warehouse with tables and relationships
Only the operating system, with Oracle to be installed by the customer
The pre-installed Oracle software, ready for the customer to create tables or solutions
A read-only copy of someone else's database
questions.explanation: In PaaS only the installed software version is provided, not an implemented solution: Oracle sits pre-installed and the customer creates tables and solutions.

questions.stem: In the Software versus Solution distinction from I Am Datapedia!, what does installing Microsoft PowerPoint represent?
options: Software installation, giving you an empty PowerPoint
questions.explanation: Installing Word, Excel or PowerPoint gives you empty applications and is called Software installation; creating diagrams in PowerPoint equals creating a Solution.

questions.stem: In the Oracle example, what is equal to creating a Solution?
options: Building physical data models, i.e. creating tables and relationships in the database
questions.explanation: Installing Oracle is installing Software; building physical data models by creating tables and relationships is creating a Solution.

questions.stem: Which of the following is handled by the Cloud provider in PaaS but by the customer in IaaS and CaaS?
options: Installing security software, encryption, DR/HA configuration and software upgrades
questions.explanation: In PaaS the provider handles security software, encryption, DR and HA and periodic upgrades, activities the customer manages under IaaS and CaaS.

questions.stem: In the laptop analogy, how is PaaS described?
options: Laptops with all possible software pre-installed, available via the Internet and ready in a few clicks
Laptops with only an operating system, everything else done by you
Laptops with pre-created diagrams ready to use
questions.explanation: PaaS is when the provider buys the laptops with all possible software pre-installed and makes them available via the Internet, ready to use in a few clicks.

questions.stem: What does a customer have to manage in terms of compute or storage under PaaS?
options: Nothing, as everything is managed automatically by the Cloud provider
questions.explanation: Customers do not have to manage any compute or storage; everything is managed automatically by the Cloud provider.

questions.stem: Why is the Software versus Solution concept described as key?
options: Because it is needed to understand the topic of SaaS
Because it explains how to configure networks
Because it defines the price of IaaS
Because it is required for Zero Trust
questions.explanation: Readers are asked to hold on to the Software and Solution concept because it is key to understanding SaaS.

questions.stem: Which statement about PaaS is FALSE?
options: Software is pre-installed and ready to use
Python can be available for the customer to start developing
The Cloud provider manages upgrades and DR/HA
An implemented business solution is delivered ready to use
The customer does not manage compute or storage
questions.explanation: PaaS provides only installed software, not an implemented solution; the ready-to-use solution is what distinguishes SaaS.
